_note: salary = requires $5 in Payday. Entry cards (recruitable) and the CEO have no salary; all other cards do. Career tree verified against the rulebook chart (page 6). topPosition = '1x' cards: copies per player count from config.perPlayerCount.employeeCopiesUsed.

employees.name: CEO
employees.ability: Always at work. 1 free recruitment action. Slots may change to 2/3/4 via reserve cards after a bank break.

employees.name: Waitress
employees.ability: Get $3 cash ($5 with 'First waitress played'). Wins ties against a restaurant with fewer waitresses.

employees.name: New Business Developer
employees.ability: Place a house or garden.

employees.name: Management Trainee
employees.ability: Black manager holding 2 subordinates.

employees.name: Pricing Manager
employees.ability: Unit price -$1 (mandatory).

employees.name: Recruiting Girl
employees.ability: Hire 1 person.

employees.name: Trainer
employees.ability: Train 1 person one step.

employees.name: Errand Boy
employees.ability: Get 1 drink of any type. ('First errand boy played' -> 2 identical drinks and +1 per source.)

employees.name: Marketing Trainee
employees.ability: Place a billboard, max duration 2, range 2.

employees.name: Kitchen Trainee
employees.ability: Produce 1 burger or 1 pizza.

employees.name: Junior Vice President
employees.ability: Black manager, 3 slots.

employees.name: Vice President
employees.ability: Black manager, 4 slots.

employees.name: Senior Vice President
employees.ability: Black manager, 5 slots.

employees.name: Executive Vice President
employees.ability: Black manager, 10 slots.

employees.name: Luxuries Manager
employees.ability: Unit price +$10 (mandatory).

employees.name: Discount Manager
employees.ability: Unit price -$3 (mandatory).

employees.name: Recruiting Manager
employees.ability: 2x: hire 1 person or $5 less salary. Unused hiring actions become $5 salary discounts (mandatory).

employees.name: HR Director
employees.ability: 4x: hire 1 person or $5 less salary. Unused hiring actions become $5 salary discounts (mandatory).

employees.name: Coach
employees.ability: 2 training slots; may train the same person two steps.

employees.name: Guru
employees.ability: 3 training slots; may train the same person up to three steps.

employees.name: Cart Operator
employees.ability: Trace a route range 2 over roads; take 2 drinks per drink symbol passed (no U-turns).

employees.name: Truck Driver
employees.ability: Route range 3 over roads; 3 drinks per drink symbol passed.

employees.name: Zeppelin Pilot
employees.ability: Route range 4 ignoring roads (up to 5 tiles, no tile twice); 2 drinks per drink symbol on flown tiles.

employees.name: Campaign Manager
employees.ability: Place a mailbox or billboard, max duration 3, range 3.

employees.name: Brand Manager
employees.ability: Place an airplane/mailbox/billboard, max duration 4, unlimited range.

employees.name: Brand Director
employees.ability: Place any campaign type, max duration 5, unlimited range.

employees.name: Burger Cook
employees.ability: Produce 3 burgers.

employees.name: Burger Chef
employees.ability: Produce 8 burgers.

employees.name: Pizza Cook
employees.ability: Produce 3 pizzas.

employees.name: Pizza Chef
employees.ability: Produce 8 pizzas.

employees.name: Local Manager
employees.ability: Place a new restaurant (COMING SOON) within range 3 tiles by road from an existing restaurant. Chain gains drive-in while active.

employees.name: Regional Manager
employees.ability: Place/move a restaurant anywhere (entrance on a road), active immediately. Chain gains drive-in while active.

employees.name: CFO
employees.ability: +50% to cash earned this round (rounded up).
